kind: Author required comparison observations; not independent review and not certification
pixel_coordinates: Region stats use original camera image downsampled to640x480, excludes 30px comparison-sheet titles.

issues.issue: Chair caps smooth-shaded and backs tall, angular and misoriented; seat arrangement deviates from RGB.
issues.action: Use flat cap normals, rounded upholstery edges; measure seat/back silhouettes and orientations across multiple original views before changing footprint.
issues.evidence: 61 chairs signed median -0.189m, 129 chairs +0.415m; inconsistent sign disallows a simple global chair translation.

issues.issue: Mirror reflections appear convex and repeated because cylinder cap normals are smooth. Mirrors should be flat.
issues.action: Flat-shade cap polygons, isolate smooth side normals and use thin physical rim; preserve single mirror objects and do not duplicate reflections.
issues.evidence: 61 wall signed median +0.039m versus 74 wall -0.229m; RGB reflection shape is stronger evidence for this shading repair than depth on mirror pixels.

issues.issue: Several pendants are absent at expected pixels or offset; model near-window/centre lamp distribution has poor edge agreement.
issues.action: Match individual rim extrema in at least two input RGB views and triangulate or ray-plane constrain; do not force one common lamp height.
issues.evidence: 82 upper region signed median +0.554m, MAE1.150m; 100 upper MAE1.417m. 129 large source top-centre lamp missing from matching location.

issues.issue: Planter vegetation consists of small central bushes; source shrubs fill trough lengths and have finer denser yellow branching.
issues.action: Distribute stem roots along each trough, check projected top/side envelope before adding fine leaves. Pot geometry is a solid proxy with soil on top, not a genuinely hollow planter.
issues.evidence: 82 shrub MAE0.786m; 91 plants median -0.517m; 108 divider median -0.249m. Mixed occlusion residuals should not be interpreted as a single surface offset.

issues.issue: Walls and floor are too pale, wood grain is weak, black inset has rippled reflection rather than crisp patterned reflections; smooth-shaded table caps look domed.
issues.action: Flat-shade tabletops; reduce large-scale bump and tune physically plausible dark materials and directional illumination against original RGB. Glazing proxy is opaque bright emission and does not reproduce transmitted sunlight.
issues.evidence: 91 floor geometry median -0.016m yet appearance strongly differs, so this is largely a shading/lighting issue.

issues.issue: Far wall, desk and crest vertical alignment remain uncertain; crest pale/missing against wall in actual render.
issues.action: Reconcile crest surface orientation and contrast, desk height measured endpoints (~0.86–0.91m) against authored 1.15m top; seek additional RGB correspondences before moving far wall.
issues.evidence: 33 back-wall median -2.428m and 155 -1.758m versus own DA3; RGB triangulation puts wall near x18.2 while DA3 region x20.6. Desk region129 median +0.904m with mixed signed residuals.

issues.issue: Column and door silhouettes do not align consistently; source column leaves image differently in sample118.
issues.action: Use stable physical correspondences and cylindrical silhouette fitting across views; rejected silhouette point matches must not be reused as measurements. Door frame members too thin in RGB.
issues.evidence: 118 column region median +0.204m, MAE0.570m. 100 glass +0.344m; 108 glass +0.042m;118 glass -0.288m shows input inconsistency.

issues.issue: Full180 predicted-depth consistency is much worse than selected ten; some native predicted input depths have extreme scale/range changes despite similar RGB.
issues.action: Reviewer should inspect recorded per-frame numerical conflicts; preserve native cameras and scale. Do not treat predicted DA3 as ground truth.
issues.evidence: Full180 MAE1.586m, AbsRel0.858; worst frames167/168 MAE>13m. Input quantiles saved separately.

issues.issue: Wall doorway details, hidden returns, botanical species, exact furniture shapes, collider envelopes and lighting powers remain inferred.
issues.action: Maintain observed/inferred distinction; collider AABBs are unvalidated conservative approximations.
